high-bailiff.final_note: The Elections Database names no candidate for this contest. The Hardwick Gazette's post-election report of the area counties' high bailiff results (November 11, 2024) reports that Essex County voters wrote in Eric Engel 89 times, the highest write-in total, of 287 write-in votes cast; he is recorded here as the seat's elected holder on that reporting. No party label attaches to a write-in candidacy.

extra_sources.note: The Hardwick Gazette, 'High Bailiffs Elected in Area Counties' (November 11, 2024): in Essex County, where there was no one on the ballot, voters wrote in Eric Engel's name 89 times out of 3,456 mostly blank votes for the position -- the county's high bailiff result in the paper's report of the official returns.
